City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
March 28, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PRESENTATION TO OUTGOING COUNCILMEMBER PAULINE DEAL – It is recommended the City Council recognize outgoing Councilmember Pauline Deal for her service and dedication to the community.
7.
SPECIAL ITEMS
7.1.
RESOLUTION NO. 17-11 RECITING THE FACTS OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON MARCH 7, 2017 AND DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY LAW - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-11 reciting that the General Municipal Election was held March 7, 2017 and declaring the results.
Item 7.1 Resolution No. 17-11 Declaring Election Results
7.2.
OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS – It is recommended the City Clerk administer the Oath of Office to John Lewis and Andrew Sarega.
7.3.
CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION – It is recommended the City Clerk initiate the procedure for reorganization of City Council.
Item 7.3 City Council Reorganization
8.
APPOINTMENTS
8.1
APPOINTMENTS TO YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council appoint Adriana Perez as a Member-at-Large and appoint Sarah Usmani as a Member of the La Mirada Youth Council for terms expiring in October 2017.
Item 8.1 Appointments
9.
CONSENT CALENDAR
9.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of March 14, 2017 and the minutes of the regular meeting of March 14, 2017.
Item 9.1 Minutes of the 3-14-17 Study Session
Item 9.1 Minutes of the 3-14-17 City Council Meeting
9.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 28, 2017 in the total amount of $2,098,505.21.
Item 9.2 Warrant Register
9.3
EXTENSION OF AGREEMENT WITH GRANICUS, INC. FOR VIDEO RECORDING OF REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a renewal of the agreement with Granicus, Inc. for video recording of regular City Council meetings on behalf of the City.
Item 9.3 Extension of Agreement with Granicus, Inc.
9.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-08, WROUGHT IRON FENCE REPAINTING AT WINDERMERE, BEHRINGER, FRONTIER AND OAK CREEK PARKS â€“ ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by A. J. Fistes Corporation; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
Item 9.4 CIP No. 2016-08 - Acceptance of Work
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 692 REVISING PURCHASING PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC PROJECTS, ADOPTING EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT PROCEDURES AND AMENDING TITLE 3 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 692 revising purchasing procedures for public projects, adopting emergency procurement procedures and amending Title 3 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
Item 10.1 Ordinance No. 692 - Second Reading
10.2
ADOPTION OF URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. 693-U AND INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 694 ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE 2017 LOS ANGELES COUNTY FIRE CODE - It is recommended the City Council adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 693-U, by title only and waive further reading; introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 694, by title only, and waive further reading; and schedule a Public Hearing for April 25, 2017 for final reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 694.
Item 10.2 Ordinances 693-U and 694 - Fire Code
